inspector.selectNodeHint: Select a node to view / edit its config
inspector.workdirNote: ⚠ Parallel nodes share the same working directory; you must avoid concurrent writes to the same file yourself (serialize edges or write to different sub-paths).
inspector.builtinVariablesDesc: Always available. Code / Doc conventionally hold the code and docs locations; a value can be any string or a directory / file you browse to.
inspector.builtinValuePlaceholder: String, or browse a directory / file
inspector.pickPathTitle: Select a directory or file for {{name}}
inspector.globalVariablesDesc: Initial variable table; all variables are treated as strings. When "disabled" is checked, downstream substitution becomes an empty string.
inspector.outputVarsShellDesc: Write with quartet_set "name" "value" in the script.
inspector.outputVarsAgentDesc: The model must output a QUARTET_OUTPUT:<name>=<value> line per variable (the marker is matched anywhere in a line; a protocol suffix is appended on save).
inspector.lastAssistantAliasDesc: After the node finishes, its raw final output is automatically written to this alias variable.
inspector.modeDesc: Mode applied when this node creates a new session.
inspector.thoughtLevelDesc: Thinking level applied when this node creates a new session.
inspector.thoughtLevelLinking: Refreshing thinking levels for the selected model…
inspector.sessionStrategyDesc: Reuses the upstream Agent's exact session — this node appends its turn to the same conversation (no copy). A multi-in-edge join reuses the session of the upstream with the greatest node ID, while the other upstreams' output variables are still merged. Two agents that can run in parallel cannot reuse the same session.
inspector.shellScriptDesc: Supports {{token}} interpolation; a non-zero exit code is treated as failure.
inspector.promptDesc: Use {{token}} to reference upstream node outputs.
inspector.clarifyPromptPlaceholder: e.g. propose a plan for this task...
inspector.clarifyPromptDesc: Optional: if set, the node runs one turn to produce a draft plan, then waits for you to discuss. Leave empty to just open an empty session. The discussion conclusion (the session's last reply) becomes this node's output.
inspector.condCannotSimplify: The current expression uses parentheses, NOT, or mixed AND/OR and cannot be shown in the builder; edit it in advanced mode only.
inspector.condAdvancedHint: Write the condition directly: reference variables as {{name}}, use 且 (AND) / 或 (OR) / 非 (NOT), parentheses allowed.
inspector.condOrderedHint: Ordered comparisons use string lexicographic order, not numeric value: e.g. "10" is less than "9".
inspector.condPreviewIncomplete: (generated after variable names are filled in)
inspector.untilCondition: Stop condition (do-while, evaluated at end of round)
inspector.fixedCount: Fixed count (≥ 0, 0 = skip sub-graph; editable mid-run, applies next round)
inspector.loopBodyHint: Drag other nodes into the dashed box to add them to the loop body.
inspector.controlNodeDesc: Control nodes are only used for the workflow entry / exit and cannot configure business actions or output variables.
inspector.hookScriptPlaceholder:
# e.g. notify when this node finishes
curl -s "$WEBHOOK" -d "$QUARTET_JOB_TITLE done"
inspector.hookScriptDesc: A side-effect shell script run after the node completes. Its output is ignored and a failure only logs — it never changes node status or stops the workflow. Available env vars: the node's variables ($Code, $Doc, ...), plus $QUARTET_JOB_TITLE, $QUARTET_JOB_ID, $QUARTET_RUN_ID, $QUARTET_NODE_ID, $QUARTET_NODE_TITLE, $QUARTET_NODE_TYPE, $QUARTET_LAST_ASSISTANT.
inspector.endHookModeDesc: Runs when this end node is reached. "Use global default script" runs the script configured in Settings → General; "Custom script" runs the script below; "Off" disables it.
inspector.frozenBanner: This node has already started / finished in this run, so its execution config cannot be changed. Nodes inside loop bodies are exempt and apply changes on the next round.
inspector.frozenBannerLoop: This loop has already started in this run, so its mode / until condition / max iterations cannot be changed. The fixed count is editable and applies on the next round.
